battle.name: 卡斯基安人入侵赫梯帝國
battle.theater: 安納托利亞北部龐廷山區邊境
battle.brief: 公元前一四三〇年前後，安納托利亞北部龐廷山區的卡斯基安人越過赫梯北方邊境，掠奪卡提納等屬地，燒毀城鎮後退回山中；赫梯王自都城派兵追入山谷，搗毀聚落，奪回牲畜與俘虜。戰役細節已無可靠記載，只能由赫梯王室文獻回溯推得。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰雙方一邊是安納托利亞北部龐廷山區的高地部族卡斯基安人（阿卡德語作卡什庫，中文亦譯卡什卡、卡斯卡），另一邊是赫梯早期王國。卡斯基安人沒有留下王名與世系，也沒有文字記載自己的政體；從赫梯方面的記載反推，他們是數十個村社結成的鬆散部族聯盟，平日以牧畜與季節性遷徙為生，戰時則由各部族首領各自率隊作戰，沒有全族同步的指揮系統，也沒有常備的攻城器械。卡斯基安人的勢力範圍在阿卡德語中稱「卡斯基安之地」，一般認為在喬魯河與克孜勒河上游之間的龐廷山區，即今土耳其北部阿爾特溫德、卡斯塔莫努與吉雷松一帶的內陸山地；其東面鄰居是卡提納、哈帕拉等赫梯屬國，南面是阿爾基與阿拉瓦，東南方通往傳說中的維盧薩，即後世所稱的特洛伊。赫梯一方是安納托利亞高原上的中央王權，首都哈圖薩位於克孜勒河上游的波加茲凱伊，國王本人即全軍最高統帥，之下設有「偉大王子」與王室軍官分領各部；邊境由卡提納、哈帕拉等屬國的守軍與本國派出的守備隊共同擔當，王室本身保有以步兵、弓兵、投石手與輕型雙馬戰車組成的中央部隊。作戰性質因此不是兩軍對陣的會戰，而是一方以劫掠、焚燒、破壞為手段游走於山地，另一方必須不斷從都城抽調縱隊去逐走他們。這場衝突在更長的歷史裡始終沒有第三方兵團加入，但西北方的維盧薩、以及後來與維盧薩結盟的卡斯基安人，都說明這一線的政治從來不孤單。
countriesEn: The two sides were the highland Kaskians of the Pontic mountains in northern Anatolia and the early Hittite kingdom. The Kaskians left behind no royal names and no lineage, and they wrote nothing about their own polity; read backwards from the Hittite accounts, they were a loose federation of several dozen village communities, living by pastoralism and seasonal movement as a rule, and in war each group of villages fought under its own chief, with no system of command for the whole people and no standing siege equipment. In Akkadian their territory was called the land of the Kasku, generally placed in the Pontic mountains between the upper Çoruh and the upper Kızılırmak, that is in the inland uplands of modern northern Turkey around Artvin, Kastamonu and Giresun; their eastern neighbours were the Hittite vassal states of Kattina and Hapala, to the south lay Alki and Arzawa, and to the south-east the road ran toward Wilusa, the Wilusa of later legend. The Hittite side was a central kingship on the Anatolian plateau, with the capital at Hattusa on the upper Kızılırmak at Boğazköy; the king himself was the supreme commander of the whole army, with the 'great prince' and royal officers commanding the several divisions; the frontier was held jointly by the garrisons of the vassal states such as Kattina and Hapala and by detachments posted from the heartland, while the crown retained a central force of infantry, archers, slingers and light two-horse chariots. The nature of the fighting was therefore never a set-piece battle between two armies, but one side raiding, burning and destroying as it moved through the mountains, and the other compelled to detach columns from the capital again and again to chase it away. Third-party contingents never joined this particular conflict, but the fact that the Kasku later allied with Wilusa in the north-west shows that this front was never politically isolated.
people: 留下姓名的赫梯人比卡斯基安人多得多，但記載這類邊境戰爭的赫梯文獻，本身是後世之王對前人戰爭的回顧。現存最關鍵的文本有三份。第一是穆爾西里二世（穆爾西里二世，約前一五六〇年至前一四九〇年在位）的《解脫之歌》：他在國境流行瘟疫之際宣布釋放囚徒與債務，此歌用很長的篇幅回顧祖父輩的出征，其中就記著哈圖西里一世曾兩度遠征「哈貝克之地」，一次平定阿拉瓦，一次平定卡斯基安；穆爾西里一世也曾遠征卡斯基安之地與阿爾基之地，並平定阿爾基。第二是哈圖西里一世（哈圖西里一世，約前一六五〇年至前一六二〇年在位）的《自辯書》，書中說卡斯基安之地背叛赫梯、焚燒了赫梯邊境城鎮舒格馬，他因而出兵討平，奪回財物與牲畜，同書還記載了饑荒年間王室開倉賑糧的舉動。第三是後世穆瓦塔里二世《穆瓦塔里之歌》與前一三世紀《阿拉克桑杜條約》裡提到的維盧薩盟友名單，把卡斯基安人放進安納托利亞西部的大國外交之中。然而，公元前一四三〇年這一次入侵本身的指揮者姓名無從考訂：赫梯文獻只以「國王」與「士兵」記之，卡斯基安人的首領也沒有留下名字，只有《解脫之歌》提到卡斯基安人數量無窮、如同蟻群。學術上還有一層定位之爭：卡斯基安之地究竟對應喬魯河谷、哈爾克帕盆地還是更北的克孜勒河上游，學者意見不一，這說明文字中的這個敵國名與考古上的文化並非能一對一對應。
peopleEn: More Hittite names survive than Kaskian ones, but the Hittite documents that record this kind of frontier war are themselves later kings' retrospectives on their predecessors' wars. Three texts are decisive. First is the 'Song of Release' of Muršili II (Muršili II, on the throne roughly 1560 to 1490 BC), who proclaimed the release of prisoners and debts while plague ran through the land; the song looks back at length over his grandfather's campaigns, and records that Hattusili I made two expeditions to the land of Habek, one destroying Arzawa and one destroying the Kasku, and that Muršili I campaigned against the land of the Kasku and the land of Alki together and destroyed the Alki. Second is the 'Apology' of Hattusili I (Hattusili I, roughly 1650 to 1620 BC), which says that the land of the Kasku rebelled against Hatti and burned the Hittite border town of Šugma, so he marched out, subdued them and recovered property and livestock; the same text also describes the crown opening its granaries to feed the citizens during a famine. Third are Muwatalli II's 'Milliad' and the list of Wilusan allies in the thirteenth-century treaty of Alaksandu, which place the Kasku inside the great-power diplomacy of western Anatolia. Yet the commander of the incursion of 1430 BC himself cannot be identified: the Hittite documents refer only to 'the king' and 'the soldiers', and the Kaskian chiefs left no name either, the 'Song of Release' remarking only that the Kasku are countless, like ants. There is a further scholarly dispute about location: whether the land of the Kasku corresponds to the Çoruh valley, the Harput basin or the upper Kızılırmak is still argued, which shows that this enemy name in the texts cannot be matched one to one with a culture in the ground.
kits: 卡面上這件埃及長矛屬於早王朝（約前三二〇〇年）的工藝，即直木杆、前端套筒式銅矛頭、尾端帶配重，並不是赫梯或卡斯基安任何一方的制式裝備；它在此處代表的是青銅時代前中期近東那種通用的直杆矛族群。小亞細亞盛產銅與砷銅，技術上完全可以做出同樣的套筒矛頭，北安納托利亞的晚期青銅時代墓葬中出土的矛頭，與卡面式樣同屬一類，柄長約二公尺，尾端常留尾錐以便插入地面或捆綁。赫梯方面的近戰主力正是這種矛，配以單刃斧、短型青銅劍與圓盾；弓箭手用角、筋與木料製成的複合弓，箭鏃有青銅與燧石兩種；早期赫梯野戰部隊還常帶投石手，以皮兜繫石彈作拋擲武器，這在安納托利亞的浮雕上清晰可辨；戰車是輕型雙馬車，一御者一戰士，用於平原追擊與偵察。卡斯基安人則是以弓為主的山地獵手，配輕便的短標槍、匕首與單刃斧，披簡單皮甲，沒有戰車與攻城器的任何記載。兩邊都沒有配備大型攻城機械：卡斯基安人靠奇襲與焚燒而非正面攻城，赫梯對付山間寨落的主要手段是封鎖谷口、斷其水源，而不是撞槌與雲梯。補給方面，赫梯遠征縱隊靠牛車與驢隊運糧，靠沿線要塞的儲糧，渡河要依賴當地的小船，這在《解脫之歌》與後來的邊防文書中都有痕跡。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the technology of the early dynastic period, about 3200 BC: a straight wooden shaft with a socketed copper head and a counterweight at the base. It was not the regulation weapon of either the Hittites or the Kasku, and stands here for that general family of straight-shafted spear common in the Near East through the earlier Bronze Age. Anatolia was rich in copper and arsenical copper, so the same socketed heads could be made there without difficulty, and the bronze heads recovered from Late Bronze Age graves in northern Anatolia belong to the same class as the one on the card, with a shaft of roughly two metres often finished with a butt-spike for standing in the ground or for lashing. The close-combat core of the Hittite force was precisely this spear, supported by single-edged axes, short bronze swords and round shields; archers used composite bows of horn, sinew and wood, with bronze or flint arrowheads; early Hittite field forces often carried slingers with stone balls held in leather cups, a weapon clearly visible in Anatolian relief; the chariots were light two-horse cars with a driver and a warrior, used for pursuit and reconnaissance on open ground. The Kasku were archers first, mountain hunters with light short javelins, daggers and single-edged axes, wearing plain leather protection, with no trace of chariots or siege engines on their side either. Neither side fielded large siege machinery: the Kasku relied on surprise and burning rather than formal siege, and the Hittite answer to the hill forts was to seal the valley mouths and cut the water, not rams and ladders. On the supply side the Hittite columns drew grain on ox carts and donkey trains, ate out of the stores held in frontier fortresses, and depended on local boats to cross the rivers, all of which leaves traces in the 'Song of Release' and in the later frontier documents.
tactics: 卡斯基安人的戰法是典型的邊地游擊：以小股武裝越過邊境，避開赫梯的巡邏與哨所，突襲邊外村莊與倉房，趕走牲畜、燒掉房舍與未收的穀物，然後在追兵合圍之前退回山區峽谷；他們熟悉每一條峪路與林道，冬天積雪封山時最為安寧，春天融雪解凍、山道泥濘難行時最容易被追。赫梯的應對則以縱隊為單位：接到警報後，王室派出一支以步兵為主、帶少量輕車的隊伍，沿固定的北方道路推進，先救援被焚的屬國、恢復邊境要塞的駐軍，再搜索山谷；正式會戰的機會很少，多數時候是追擊殘敵與掃蕩空寨。會戰時的陣形可以從同時期其他赫梯戰役的浮雕推想：步兵以盾牆與長矛線構成正面，弓手在後方放箭，車兵配置在兩翼與側後，負責追擊潰退的敵人與掩護側面。圍困山間聚落時，赫梯的做法是先封住通往谷內的道路與水源，迫使其在糧水耗盡後下山，再以密集箭雨與近身長矛完成最後的衝鋒。需要說明的是，這些陣形細節並非來自這場戰爭的記載，關於卡斯基安人的戰鬥過程，赫梯文獻幾乎沒有留下任何戰術細節，只有《解脫之歌》提到他們不循常規陣式作戰、靠突然襲擊取勝，這一點與後世所有關於安納托利亞邊地游擊的描述一致。
tacticsEn: The Kaskian method was classic frontier skirmishing: small bands crossed the border, slipped past Hittite patrols and pickets, struck the villages and store-houses outside the line, drove off livestock, burned the houses and the standing grain, and withdrew into the gorges of the mountains before the pursuers could close; they knew every ravine and forest track, and were safest in winter when the passes were under snow, and most exposed in the spring thaw when the roads turned to mud and could barely be used. The Hittite response was organised in columns: on receiving the alarm the crown sent out a force mainly of infantry with a few light cars, which advanced along the fixed northern roads, first relieving the burned vassal states and restoring the garrisons of the frontier fortresses, and then searching the valleys; a real set-piece battle was rare, and the work was usually the pursuit of broken bands and the clearing of empty settlements. The battle order can be reconstructed from the reliefs of other Hittite campaigns of the same age: infantry formed the front with a wall of shields and a line of spears, the archers shot from behind, and the chariots were posted on the wings and at the rear to chase the fugitives and cover the flanks. When a hill settlement was invested, the Hittite practice was to close the roads into the valley and its water first, and to force the defenders down the mountain once grain and water ran out, and then to finish with dense arrow-fall and the spear line at close quarters. It must be said that none of these tactical details comes from this war: the Hittite documents preserve almost nothing about how the fighting with the Kasku was actually done, beyond the remark in the 'Song of Release' that they did not fight in the ordinary way but won by sudden attack, which agrees with every later description of Anatolian frontier irregular warfare.
data: 可核對的數字極少，這本身就是這場戰爭的特點。《解脫之歌》列出的王室遠征清單裡，指向卡斯基安之地的出征是兩次：哈圖西里一世一次，穆爾西里一世一次，後者並在同一支隊伍中平定了阿爾基；同一份清單另有哈圖西里二世平定阿拉瓦一次。這三次北方遠征之後，赫梯王室不再把卡斯基安列為主要戰場，直到前一三世紀的《阿拉克桑杜條約》與《穆瓦塔里之歌》才又出現其名，說明在公元前一四三〇年前後，赫梯面對的北方邊患是長期而反覆的。全部文獻都沒有留下兵力、俘虜、牲畜或損失的數目，這與新王國時代把戰果逐項刻上石柱的做法大不相同，說明早期王室的戰爭記錄仍以敘事為主。唯一帶有數量色彩的是《解脫之歌》對敵人規模的形容，即卡斯基安人數量無窮、如同蟻群。距離可以估算：從首都哈圖薩到龐廷山區前線，直線距離約四百五十公里，遠征縱隊在沒有車道的山地行軍往往要走上數星期。考古方面，龐廷山區一帶晚期青銅時代聚落密集，武器小件的散布與青銅原料的消耗都高於同期的赫梯核心平原，與一個長期以劫掠維持經濟的部族社會相合。至於月份，文獻完全沒有記載，此處填四月，只是依赫梯王室歷來在春末夏初用兵的季節所作的合理推測，並非史料所載。
dataEn: Very little can be checked numerically, and that is itself a feature of this war. In the list of royal campaigns given by the 'Song of Release', two expeditions point at the land of the Kasku: one by Hattusili I and one by Muršili I, the latter taking the Alki in the same column; the same list adds one expedition by Hattusili II against Arzawa. After those three northern campaigns the Hittite crown no longer names the Kasku as a main theatre, and the name does not reappear until the treaty of Alaksandu and the 'Milliad' in the thirteenth century BC, which shows that the northern trouble around 1430 BC was chronic and recurrent. No document anywhere gives numbers for men, prisoners, livestock or losses, which is quite unlike the New Kingdom practice of carving every captured man, animal and chariot onto a pillar; early royal war records were still narrative in character. The only quantity-like statement is the description of the enemy in the 'Song of Release' as countless, like ants. Distance can be estimated: in a straight line it is about 450 kilometres from the capital of Hattusa to the Pontic frontier, and a column marching without roads in such country took a matter of weeks. On the archaeological side, Late Bronze Age settlements are dense in the Pontic region, and the scatter of small metalwork and the consumption of raw copper both run higher there than on the Hittite core plain of the same date, which fits a society that lived for a long time on plunder. As for the month, the record is simply silent; April is entered here only as a reasonable inference from the season in which the Hittite crown customarily took the field, and is not a fact of the sources.
cause: 打起來的理由可以分幾層。遠的一層是赫梯早期王國在安納托利亞高原上的擴張：從哈圖西里一世起，王室先後平定西部的阿拉瓦、北部的卡提納與哈帕拉，把勢力推過喬魯河，進入龐廷山區的邊緣。卡斯基安人的生活原本建立在山區與低地之間的季節性交換上，夏季在高山放牧，冬季下到谷地取得穀物與鹽，牲畜與穀物的往來路線就是他們的通道。赫梯修築的邊境要塞、派駐的守軍與被徵收的貢賦，正落在這些通道上，於是原本的往來被讀成掠奪，而掠奪又被讀成叛亂。直接的一層是模式性的：卡斯基安人不尋求會戰，也沒有佔領赫梯城市的企圖，他們挑某些年成襲擊邊境城鎮，燒掉木造房舍與倉房，趕走牲畜便退走；對王權而言，這類襲擊年年發生、鄰國不寧，無論規模大小都必須回應，否則赫梯在北部邊境與其屬國的威信會被耗光。第三層是體制上的：赫梯王室需要以遠征邊境來展示王權的守護力量，同時藉由向屬國收取保護費來鞏固附庸秩序，而被劫的屬國往往正是王的兄弟或盟友，因此每一次襲擊都被提到王室層次處理。必須承認的是，公元前一四三〇年那一次入侵的確切導火線已經不可考，赫梯文獻只留下結果而略去緣由；以上是由前後兩百年的同類記載歸納出的通例。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting can be read at several depths. The deepest is the expansion of the early Hittite kingdom across the Anatolian plateau: from Hattusili I onward the crown pacified Arzawa in the west and Kattina and Hapala in the north, pushing its line across the Çoruh and into the edge of the Pontic mountains. Kaskian life had rested on the seasonal exchange between upland and lowland, with the herds moved to the high pastures in summer and brought down into the valleys in winter for grain and salt, and the routes the animals took were the routes of exchange. Hittite frontier fortresses, Hittite garrisons and Hittite tribute fell exactly across those routes, so that ordinary movement came to be read as plunder, and plunder came to be read as rebellion. The immediate layer is a matter of pattern: the Kasku did not seek a set-piece battle and had no intention of holding a Hittite city; in certain years they struck at the border towns, burned the timber houses and the granaries, drove off the animals, and then withdrew. For the crown, raids of this kind, annual and unsettling to the neighbours, had to be answered whatever their size, or the authority of Hatti over its northern frontier and its vassals would be worn away. Third is the institutional layer: the Hittite court needed the expedition to the frontier to demonstrate the king's role as protector, while drawing protection dues from the vassals to tighten the order of dependence, and the states that were plundered were often the king's own brothers or allies, so every raid was raised to the level of the crown. It must be admitted that the precise trigger of the incursion of 1430 BC can no longer be recovered: the Hittite documents keep the outcome and drop the reason, and what lies above is a generalisation drawn from two centuries of comparable entries.
impact: 影響最深遠的一層，是赫梯北方邊境體制的定型。所謂「卡斯基安問題」逼出了一整套邊防做法：在喬魯河與克孜勒河上游之間修築一連串可以屯兵的邊境要塞，常駐守備兵力與儲糧，把卡提納、哈帕拉這類小邦國留在最前線當作緩衝，王室本身則在都城與前線之間維持一條可以重複使用的道路。這套做法在此後數百年裡一直是安納托利亞邊疆政治的基本樣板，也讓赫梯在面對西部阿拉瓦、南方阿爾基與東部米坦尼時，能同時維持多條戰線而不至於崩解。第二是對王室的消耗：從哈圖西里一世到穆爾西里二世，幾乎每一位早期赫梯王都要抽身北征，這意味著每一次北方遠征都伴隨著西線與南線的鬆動，王位繼承與王室內部的權力安排也屢次在遠征之後被牽動。第三是書寫傳統：哈圖西里一世的《自辯書》與穆爾西里二世的《解脫之歌》確立了把王室戰爭編成「王室譜系加戰功」的敘事體例，日後新王國時代把每次遠征的俘虜、牲畜與戰車數目刻上石柱的做法，源頭正在這裡。第四是考古與學術：卡斯基安人讓學者注意到安納托利亞北部晚期青銅時代文化的獨立面貌，把文字中的一個敵國名變成一個考古學問題，龐廷山區的聚落、陶器與武器散布從此成為「邊境社會」研究的核心材料。最後是外交上的投射：卡斯基安人後來與維盧薩站在同一邊，這一段常被引申為傳說中特洛伊聯軍的影子，但這是後人的推想，並非當時的因果。
impactEn: The deepest consequence was the fixing of the Hittite northern frontier system. The 'Kasku problem' produced a whole way of doing things on a frontier: a chain of forts able to hold troops built along the upper Çoruh and Kızılırmak, permanent garrisons and stored grain, small states such as Kattina and Hapala left in the foremost line as a buffer, and a road between the capital and the front that could be used again and again. This pattern remained the basic model of Anatolian frontier politics for centuries afterwards, and it allowed the Hittites to keep several fronts open at once against Arzawa in the west, Alki in the south and Mitanni in the east without collapsing. The second consequence was the drain on the crown: from Hattusili I to Muršili II nearly every early Hittite king had to break off for a northern campaign, and each such expedition loosened the western and southern fronts at the same time, while questions of succession and of the balance of power inside the royal family were repeatedly entangled with the aftermath of a march. Third came the tradition of writing: the 'Apology' of Hattusili I and the 'Song of Release' of Muršili II established the form of the royal war narrative, a genealogy of kings followed by a list of exploits, and the New Kingdom habit of cutting every campaign's prisoners, livestock and captured chariots onto a pillar of stone has its origin here. Fourth is archaeology and scholarship: the Kasku led scholars to notice the independent character of Late Bronze Age culture in northern Anatolia, turning an enemy name in the texts into an archaeological problem, and the settlements, pottery and metalwork of the Pontic region became the core material of the study of frontier societies. Last is the diplomatic projection: the Kasku later stood on the same side as Wilusa, and this has often been read as the shadow of the legendary coalition of Troy, but that is a later inference and not a cause at the time.
result: 結果可以分短期與長期兩層。短期看，公元前一四三〇年前後的這一次入侵與赫梯的反擊，與此前此後所有同類事件一樣，沒有留下勝負的記錄：赫梯文獻只說「卡斯基安人退走」，既沒有俘虜與繳獲的數目，也沒有宣布征服或附庸化。這正是邊境游擊戰的典型收場，入侵者退回山中，守方恢復被焚的城鎮與被擄的牲畜，邊界線大致回到原處。長期看，赫梯從未能在北方消滅卡斯基安人：卡斯基安人沒有被同化為附庸，也沒有被逐出山區，赫梯則無法向北推進，北方邊界在之後數百年裡大致維持在喬魯河上游一帶。於是赫梯帝國的重心被迫留在安納托利亞高原的南半部與西半部，把注意力放在阿拉瓦、敘利亞與米坦尼身上，這一取捨在後來對海上聯盟的戰爭裡顯出代價：前一三世紀，當西北方的聯盟發動大規模進攻時，赫梯無法從北面調來任何援軍。對卡斯基安人自身而言，這種「打不贏、也趕不走」的格局反而維持了他們的獨立，直到青銅時代末期，這個名字才從赫梯的敵國名錄上淡出。就這場戰爭本身而言，可以確定的只有三件事：它發生在安納托利亞北部；它屬於一個延續兩百年的邊境衝突，而不是一場有明確勝負的會戰；它的詳細經過已隨同當時的記載一同散佚，今天能重建的，是它的模式，而不是它的戰況。
resultEn: The result divides into a short term and a long term. In the short term, the incursion of around 1430 BC and the Hittite counter-stroke ended like every comparable event before and after it, with no record of a decided battle: the Hittite documents say only that the Kasku withdrew, and record neither prisoners nor booty, and declare neither conquest nor the making of vassals. That is the usual ending of frontier raiding: the raiders fall back into the hills, the defenders restore the burned towns and the taken animals, and the boundary line settles back roughly where it was. In the long term the Hittites never destroyed the Kasku in the north: they were neither absorbed as vassals nor driven from their mountains, and the Hittites in turn could not push their frontier forward, so the northern line stayed for several centuries along the upper Çoruh. The weight of the Hittite state was therefore forced onto the southern and western halves of the Anatolian plateau and onto Arzawa, Syria and Mitanni, and the price of that choice became clear later, in the thirteenth century BC, when the great coalition from the north-west attacked and no reinforcement could be drawn from the northern flank. For the Kasku themselves, a situation in which they could not win and could not be driven away preserved their independence, and their name faded from the Hittite roll of enemies only as the Bronze Age ended. As for this war in particular, only three things can be stated with certainty: it was fought in northern Anatolia; it belonged to a frontier conflict running for two hundred years rather than to a battle with a clear outcome; and its details are lost with the documents of the time, so that what can be rebuilt today is its pattern and not its course.
